Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier as chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL5727368. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727368. Return rows sorted by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
